transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metro M11 connects the airport with Gayrettepe, and since 20 June 2026 it has been extended to Halkalı. Havaist buses leave from the transport level, Level −2 for many districts of the city, including Beşiktaş, Kadıköy, Aksaray, Sultanahmet (Çatladıkapı) and Esenler bus station. İETT city buses: 5 routes to the centre.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: YOTEL hotel right in the terminal: 171 cabins in the landside area (opposite check-in counters P) and 280 in the departure area (YOTELAIR, zone A–B), the latter only for passengers departing on international flights. Bookings from 4 hours. Hourly YOTELAIR Sleepcabins are opposite the iGA Lounge entrance, one floor up, walk-in only (no advance booking).

kids.title: With children
kids.text: There is a mother and child room, play areas in five themes with a total area of 700 m², free buggy rides for passengers with children under 2, separate family parking spaces and family security checkpoints.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Multi-level car park under one roof, round-the-clock video surveillance and security. From 1 January 2024, without a season pass payment is per day; the price is calculated on the airport website. Paying through the airport app gives 10% off (except season passes for 15 and 30 days). Valet parking is at the CIP terminal entrance.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free unlimited internet: iGA Wi‑Fi network, login with a phone number and an SMS password or with an access code issued by kiosks in the terminal after scanning a passport.
